thread:
Priya (SecOps): Postmortem is up — https://docs.redwood.ai/postmortems/authz-escalation-1808129999. We need owners for the remediation items and a single-line acceptance criteria for each so I can seed the tracker.
Maya K: I'll take token validation improvements and CI enforcement. Creating INF-5710. Short acceptance: CI fails if token validation absent and tests cover both cache hit and cold paths. ETA 2026-04-14.
Liam O: I'll own the permission clean-up and drift detection. INF-5711. Short acceptance: reconciler detects drift + removes or flags stale grants and creates a rollbackable change. ETA 2026-04-06.
Ops Oncall: I'll handle secrets rotation automation and ops runbook updates. INF-5712. Short acceptance: non-destructive rotation job merged + runbook with verification steps. ETA 2026-04-21.
audit-bot: Postmortem "AuthZ: token reuse -> elevation" added to #incidents. RT card RT-129 created.
Priya (SecOps): Two recurring patterns we pulled out: 1) stale service tokens surviving staging->prod syncs; 2) silent permission drift after vendor CI jobs. Need detectors + owners.
Maya K: I'll add a nightly job that lists tokens unused > 30d and emit a metric `stale_service_tokens_count`. Alert if > 3.
Liam O: For drift, I'll prototype a periodic reconcile that diffs `infra/rbac.yaml` vs live grants; if diff>0 open INF-5713 for investigation. Will wire a summary message to #incidents.
Priya (SecOps): Please paste compact owner lines I can copy to the tracker. Keep them exactly one line like ticket | owner | due | done-criteria.
Maya K: INF-5710 | owner: Maya K | due: 2026-04-14 | done-criteria: CI gate + unit/integration tests for cache hit/miss + canary pass.
Liam O: INF-5711 | owner: Liam O | due: 2026-04-06 | done-criteria: reconciler running, stale grants flagged/removed, RBAC mapping + rollback doc.
Ops Oncall: INF-5712 | owner: Ops Oncall | due: 2026-04-21 | done-criteria: rotation job merged in infra, dry-run & verification steps in runbook.
Priya (SecOps): Add a short detection acceptance too: who is on the weekly digest first month?
Maya K: I'll take first 4 weeks of the digest.
Liam O: Add me too.
Ops Oncall: I'll subscribe for the month after that.
incident-bot: Reminder: remediation checkpoint scheduled 2026-03-31 10:00 PT in #incidents.
Priya (SecOps): Risks to call out: vendor deploys sometimes apply grants outside infra repo, and sync tooling currently copies token files without expiry checks. We should add CI blocks.
Liam O: I'll draft a deploy-time check that rejects role changes not present in `infra/rbac.yaml` unless approved via PR. Will land a blocker in vendor CI.
Maya K: I'll add a deploy-time token age check that fails the sync if any token_age_days > 30 in the manifest.
Ops Oncall: For staged rotations, I'll add a weekly canary rotation and a post-rotation smoke test that validates token flows.
Priya (SecOps): Great. Link PRs to the INF tickets and update the RT card. If anyone is blocked ping me or @security-leads. Closing thread after the checkpoint. :white_check_mark:
Maya K: Opening INF-5710 PR now.
Liam O: Reconciler prototype pushed to branch, opening INF-5711 shortly.
Ops Oncall: Draft rotation job in infra repo, will request review tomorrow.
